name: Explora Patagonia Torres Del Paine
positioning: All-inclusive wilderness lodge, officially Explora Torres del Paine, on the shores of Lake Pehoe inside Torres del Paine National Park, with more than 40 guided Explorations included in the stay
best_for: Active travelers who want guided hikes, horseback rides and glacier trips included in the stay
Travelers who want to stay inside Torres del Paine National Park rather than commute in from Puerto Natales

facts.text: The lodge sits on the shores of Lake Pehoe in Torres del Paine National Park.
The lodge was built by Chilean architect Jose Cruz Ovalle.
Cypress, lenga and almendrillo woods play a fundamental role in the lodge's design.
Cordillera Paine Rooms have views of the Paine Massif.
Salto Chico Rooms have views of the Salto Chico waterfall.
Guests enjoy complimentary transfers across the lake aboard Explora's own ferry.
More than 40 guided Explorations are included in the stay.
Explorations are designed for small groups of no more than eight guests.
Each evening an Explora guide meets with guests to tailor the next day's Explorations to their preferences.
Explorations are led by guides trained at Explora's own School of Guides.
The stay includes all meals and beverages, with an open bar.
The rate includes national park entrance fees and round-trip transfers between Puerto Natales and the lodge.

highlights.text: Explora has a private 15,000-acre conservation reserve in Torres del Paine National Park.
Guests can ride Explora's own rare breed of Patagonian horses, with access to Explora's own horse stable.
Near the lodge, the spa has a heated indoor pool, a steam sauna and four open-air hot tubs, all with views to the Paine River.
A catamaran ride over Grey Lake takes guests to Grey Glacier, part of the Southern Ice Fields.
Between October and April, weather permitting, gauchos hold a Quincho, a traditional Patagonian gathering with roast lamb overlooking the Paine granite towers, at Explora's Estancia 2 de Enero ranch.

considerations.text: Because of the remote location, Wi-Fi in rooms and common areas may vary in reliability.
Spa facilities are included, but individual spa treatments carry an additional charge.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires extensive travel planning and longer flight connections.
